long_biography.plain_text:
Keeree Kanjanapas moved from Bangkok to Hong Kong as a teenager, joining a family whose businesses ranged from watches to eyewear. He made his own mark through a regional Puma sportswear distributorship, then returned to Thailand and formed property developer Tanayong. A Bangkok transport concession shifted his focus from land development to an elevated urban rail system.

Kanjanapas committed his wider assets to complete the Skytrain after the Asian financial crisis pushed his group toward insolvency. The line opened in 1999, and a long restructuring preserved his control before the business recovered through passenger fares and infrastructure financing. He remains founder and chairman of BTS Group, while son Kavin has served as chief executive since 2015 and leads day-to-day growth.
